verdict.rationale: Veriff's docs cover the full loop. Sessions are created server-side via POST /v1/sessions. The JS SDK produces a session URL to redirect to, the InContext SDK embeds the flow in your page, and native, React Native and Flutter SDKs provide a built-in flow so you never collect media yourself. Results come back through decision webhooks or by polling /v1/sessions/{id}/decision. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation that the hosted flow captures both document and selfie in one session (only implied by the liveness and document/NFC docs).
